name: <app-id>-bridge
description: <App name>'s MCP tools, for Cowork and the Code tab. Needs <App name> open.
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop to the MCP server <App name> runs at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp. The bridge forwards only to this computer. When <App name> is closed it reports no tools, then adds them when <App name> opens.
